Definition: from G4862 and G599; to decease (literally) in company with, or (figuratively), similarly to:--be dead (die) with.
BiblicalUsage: Peter vows that even if he should die with Jesus he will not deny Him, Paul says it is a faithful saying that if we are dead with Him we shall also live with Him, and he tells the Corinthians they are in his heart to die and live with them. Dying with Christ is the condition of living with Him, and dying with His people is the bond of the ministry.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that dying with Christ is the way to live with Him, and I believe this faithful saying is the whole of the gospel in one line.
